description: getDisplayName() crashes on null or incomplete user objects; add guards so it always returns a safe name.
prompt:
You are fixing a small JavaScript bug.

File: work/swe-02/user.js

The exported function `getDisplayName(user)` should return the user's trimmed display name, or `'Anonymous'` as a safe fallback. Currently it crashes (`TypeError`) on `null`/`undefined` users or when `profile`/`name` is missing.

Requirements:
- Never throw for any input (`null`, `undefined`, `{}`, `{profile:{}}`, non-string names, etc.).
- Return the trimmed string when `user.profile.name` is a non-empty string (`' Ada '` -> `'Ada'`).
- Return `'Anonymous'` when the name is missing, not a string, or blank/whitespace-only.
- Keep `module.exports = { getDisplayName }` and use no external dependencies.

Edit work/swe-02/user.js so the behavior above holds.
title: Add null guard to getDisplayName()
